title: Morning Robotics Scan
report:
## Retail Humanoids at Shanghai Store

### The Breakthrough
Six G2 AGIBOT humanoids completed 1,730 tasks over a 24‑hour shift, handling 683 greetings, 369 item deliveries and 147 coffees without human operators, showing autonomous multi‑modal service in a live retail environment.

### The Caveats
No baseline or comparative metric is provided, so performance relative to existing solutions or humans is unclear.

## Social Humanoid Interaction

### The Breakthrough
Social Humanoid uses a hierarchical policy that tokenizes human and robot motion, enabling a 29‑DoF Unitree G1 to generate and execute coordinated whole‑body motions aligned with a partner’s movements, demonstrated both in simulation and on the physical robot with a new 260‑hour benchmark.

### The Caveats
No comparison to existing methods is provided, leaving improvement unverified.

## Heavy‑Lift Fire‑Fighting Drones

### The Breakthrough
Chinese fire services are deploying heavy‑lift cargo drones such as DJI FlyCart 200 retrofitted with water buckets, foam cannons and drone bays on fire trucks, allowing aerial delivery of suppression agents directly to fire scenes.

### The Caveats
No field trials or performance data are provided, so effectiveness remains unproven.

## VisionSIM Multi‑Modal Perception Simulator

### The Breakthrough
VisionSIM models raw physical measurements for cameras, event, SPAD, iToF/dToF and thermal sensors, exposing fine‑grained parameters that reproduce realistic artefacts like LiDAR pile‑up and phase wrapping, and releases a synchronized indoor dataset for side‑by‑side sensor comparison.

### The Caveats
The paper provides no evaluation or comparison to existing simulators, leaving claimed physical accuracy unverified.

## VFlash Visual Planning

### The Breakthrough
VFlash predicts entire visual primitives in a single forward pass using a lightweight drafter, achieving roughly 25× faster generation and higher accuracy (70.2% success vs 62.6% baseline) on 2D/3D trajectory tasks, potentially accelerating perception‑to‑action pipelines.

### The Caveats
Gains are demonstrated only against a single autoregressive baseline, with no broader comparisons.

## Latent RL Priors for Dexterous Manipulation

### The Breakthrough
A two‑stage framework distills large‑scale RL rollouts into a flow‑matching decoder using privileged proprioception, then trains a visual encoder to map raw images to the decoder’s latent task context, reducing required visual demos by up to 10× on simulated door‑lifting and 5× on bimanual assembly.

### The Caveats
Results are limited to simulation on three tasks, with no real‑world hardware validation.

## SO101‑Nexus Learning Stack

### The Breakthrough
SO101‑Nexus unifies teleoperation recording, behavior cloning and PPO‑based RL for the SO‑101 arm in MuJoCo, leveraging LeRobot datasets and a GPU‑accelerated Warp backend to train end‑to‑end policies entirely in simulation before transfer to the physical robot.

### The Caveats
No quantitative evaluation or comparison to existing frameworks is offered.

## nano‑ros Embedded ROS2 Client

### The Breakthrough
nano‑ros provides a no‑std Rust ROS2 client for microcontrollers and RTOSes, featuring zero‑copy CDR serialization, multiple DDS back‑ends and formal verification pipelines, enabling ROS2 connectivity on bare‑metal devices.

### The Caveats
Evaluation is limited to QEMU simulation with no real‑hardware benchmarks.

## China Robot Lifetime ID Draft

### The Breakthrough
The draft rule mandates a tamper‑proof 29‑character ID embedded in every domestically manufactured robot, with mandatory registration of components and software within 20 days, extending a scheme already applied to over 28,000 humanoids to roughly 795 k industrial robots produced Jan‑Sept 2026.

### The Caveats
Enforcement details, testing and timeline are absent, so safety benefits are unproven.

### Priority
The Shanghai retail demo is the most concrete evidence yet of service‑oriented humanoids operating autonomously in a public setting, making it the ideal entry point for today’s scan.

### One action
Watch the live‑stream replay to see how task scheduling and navigation were integrated across the six robots.

### What to watch
VisionSIM, VFlash, and Latent RL Priors each aim to bridge the gap between simulated training and real‑world performance—VisionSIM improves sensor realism, VFlash speeds up visual plan generation, and Latent RL Priors cut demonstration data needs. Together they signal a trend toward more data‑efficient and physically accurate pipelines.
